source_documents.title: HDFC Bank Q1 FY27 Investor Conference Call Transcript

what_changed_recently.headline: Merger Integration Stabilized with Loan Growth Re-accelerating
what_changed_recently.detail: Core deposit mobilization accelerated past loan growth, bringing Credit-to-Deposit (CD) ratio down towards historical comfort zones (~100%).

what_changed_recently.headline: Gross NPA Maintained at Pristine 1.33% with High Provision Coverage
what_changed_recently.detail: Asset quality across retail, mortgage, and wholesale books remains resilient with net NPA at 0.39% and PCR at 71%.

what_changed_recently.headline: Branch Network Reaches 9,000+ Touchpoints Across India
what_changed_recently.detail: Accelerated semi-urban and rural branch additions to deepen CASA deposit capture and retail mortgage origination.

growth_drivers.description: Cross-selling bundled home loans, personal loans, and credit cards directly to non-mortgage banking account holders.
growth_drivers.execution_status: Over 80% of new home loan customers now onboarded directly via bank branch touchpoints.
growth_drivers.expected_impact: Sticky long-duration asset book with zero acquisition intermediary brokerage fees.
growth_drivers.source_quote: Expanding home loan distribution across the comprehensive bank branch network

promise_vs_delivery.past_promise: Execute legal amalgamation of HDFC Ltd into HDFC Bank seamlessly
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Completed merger integration with zero regulatory disruptions and unified treasury.
promise_vs_delivery.source_quote: Successfully concluded structural amalgamation and unified operational platforms

promise_vs_delivery.past_promise: Maintain best-in-class asset quality through merger transition
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Gross NPA remained pristine at 1.33%, among lowest in private banking sector.
promise_vs_delivery.source_quote: Asset quality ratios maintained within guided historical thresholds

promise_vs_delivery.past_promise: Restore Net Interest Margin (NIM) back to pre-merger 3.8-4.0% band
promise_vs_delivery.actual_outcome: Core NIM currently at 3.46% as high-cost liabilities run off and liquidity buffers are digested.
promise_vs_delivery.source_quote: NIM expansion will follow deposit repricing and gradual CD ratio normalization

segment_demand_trends.trend_summary: Steady 14-16% credit growth driven by auto loans, personal loans, and SME commercial banking.

company_specific_metrics.context: Expected to expand 20-30 bps as high-cost legacy borrowings mature
Industry-leading asset quality with 71% provision coverage
Deposit franchise re-accelerating through branch additions

risks_and_cash.working_capital_and_cash_bottlenecks: Not applicable for banking operations; credit-to-deposit ratio is the primary liquidity indicator.
risks_and_cash.debt_and_interest_trajectory: Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) robust at 18.8% against regulatory minimum of 11.5%.
risks_and_cash.margin_and_cost_pressures: Competitive deposit pricing in banking system temporarily keeping cost of funds elevated.
operational_bottlenecks: Branch productivity gestation time for newly opened rural and semi-urban branches.

stocker_view.overall_takeaway: HDFC Bank offers an attractive structural franchise compounder at an undemanding valuation (~14x P/E) as merger overhangs dissipate and NIM expands.
positive_triggers: Deposit growth outpacing credit growth, steadily reducing the CD ratio.
High-cost HDFC Ltd debt maturing over the next 12-24 months, directly expanding NIM.
Pristine asset quality with zero systemic retail credit stress.
main_risks: Intense industry competition for low-cost CASA deposits.
Regulatory changes to liquidity coverage ratio (LCR) requirements.
what_to_watch: Quarterly deposit mobilization run-rate relative to loan growth.
